com.zynthec.zLoader.name: zLoader
com.zynthec.zLoader.subtitle: Independent SideStore fork for iPhone and iPad.
com.zynthec.zLoader.localizedDescription: Sideloading and manage apps, deveoloper profiles and much more in zynthec style.
com.zynthec.zLoader.versionDescription:
Apple login: one delayed, fresh Windows-identity attempt after an HTTP 503 during initialization. Password proofs and verification codes are never replayed by this fallback. Non-plist HTTP failures now identify the status and login phase instead of showing HTML. The original identity remains in use outside GrandSlam. Existing pushed-code 2FA support is retained.

Local compatibility tests, iPhone Release build and package/signature checks passed. Actual Apple-account login still requires validation on the iPhone. Apple-authorized signing and matching host/widget profiles are required; use an external local VPN.

com.zynthec.zLocalVPN.name: zLocalVPN
com.zynthec.zLocalVPN.subtitle: Independent local tunnel for developer apps.
com.zynthec.zLocalVPN.localizedDescription: A native local developer VPN based on LocalDevVPN and StosVPN. Uses 10.7.1.1/32 and 10.7.0.1/32 by default, with connection controls and configurable addresses. Requires Apple-authorized Network Extension signing for both the app and its VPN extension. Not an internet VPN.
com.zynthec.zLocalVPN.versionDescription: First independent zLocalVPN release: native controls, local loopback packet tunnel, connection log, English and German UI, and preserved upstream credits. Real-device VPN and developer-app compatibility still require validation.
